title: Specify replacement-note provenance before task-sync note authoring
outcome: Specify replacement-note provenance before task-sync note authoring
acceptance: Greg's exact durable-store decision is recorded before any implementation of replacement-note provenance; the proposal identifies shared draft/prepared note shape, original note ID/machine linkage, immutable minted-ID retry, canonical import-origin conversion and any migration/repair impact.

The agreed future design preserves original note bytes/IDs, rejects arbitrary new ID-bearing drafts and wrong-kind/task/author/body collisions, distinguishes exact native-note self-echo, and includes a cross-machine stable provenance and disclosure/profile test plan without claiming authentication.
